Title: Wellness Care
Intro: A healthy start, and support for every year after. Preventive care tailored to your companion’s age, lifestyle, and needs.

Title: Injury + Illness
Intro: When something doesn’t seem right, we’re here to listen, examine, and help you understand the next step.

Title: Dentistry
Intro: Thoughtful dental care to help keep your pet’s mouth comfortable and healthy.

Title: Soft Tissue Surgery
Intro: From routine procedures to more involved care, our team will talk you through your pet’s treatment and recovery.

Title: Urgent Care
Intro: For unexpected concerns, call the clinic to discuss your pet’s needs and availability.

Title: Exotics
Intro: Big personalities come in every shape and size. Care for the furry, feathered, and scaly members of your family.
Items: Small mammals: rabbits, guinea pigs, rats, and hamsters
Lizards: bearded dragons, leopard geckos, and chameleons
Birds: parakeets, cockatiels, parrots, chickens, and ducks

Title: Naturopathic Care
Intro: Discuss complementary care options with Dr. Lauren Davis and find out what may be appropriate for your companion.

More.Title: Acupuncture
More.Text: Ask Dr. Davis about acupuncture and whether it belongs in your pet’s care plan.

More.Title: Veterinary orthopedic manipulation
More.Text: A gentle approach to joint manipulation. The veterinarian can explain the procedure and discuss whether it is appropriate for your pet.

More.Title: Herbs and nutraceuticals
More.Text: Discuss herbal products and nutritional supplements with the veterinarian, including how they fit with your pet’s current medications.

More.Title: Other complementary options
More.Text: The clinic also lists homeopathy and Reiki among its services. Contact the team to discuss these options and your pet’s needs.

Title: In-house Pharmacy
Intro: Pick up medications and supplies through the clinic, or explore our online ordering partners.
